checks.command: l4 run amla-cases-obligations.l4; l4 run amla-cases-wills-inheritance.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 78, 79 and Third Schedule (Mosque Building and Mendaki Fund contributions and opt-out), s 88A(5) (halal certificates and marks), ss 94B, 95, 96, 97 and Fourth Schedule (who may solemnise a marriage, polygamous and under-18 marriages, janda, consents for minors), ss 102(5) and 130(2) (attending the Syariah Court after divorce), and Part 9 offences ss 129 to 140; and, added 12 October 2026 for REQ-0282, Part 7 wills and inheritance: the will restriction by the school professed (ss 110, 111), intestacy and partial intestacy (s 112), the Mazhab in the probate affidavit (s 113), the Syariah Court inheritance certificate (s 115), letters of administration (s 116) and a married woman's will (s 118), with the school's limit on a bequest taken as an input because the Act states none
